description: Configuration interface for the AI Voice Agent, handling lead retention, normal calls, and WhatsApp calls.

layout_structure.topbar: Page Title: 'Voice Agent Settings', Action: 'Buy Credits' (Ghost Button)
layout_structure.main_area: Two-column layout (Main settings on left, live preview/stats on right).

panels.title: Voice Selection
panels.content: A grid of voice profile cards (Male, Female, Accents). Play button icon to preview.
panels.active_state: Selected card has a Kournikova border and subtle glow.

panels.title: Call Scripts & Objectives
panels.content: Rich text area for 'Primary Objective' (e.g., 'Book a meeting', 'Qualify lead'). Input fields for fallback messages.

panels.title: Call Triggers
panels.content: Toggle switches for 'Call on missed web form', 'Call after WhatsApp template opened but unreplied for 24h'.

panels.title: Agent Status
panels.content: Large toggle switch (Active/Paused). 'Currently handling 3 active calls.'

panels.title: Credit Balance
panels.content: Large bold text showing '2,450 mins remaining'. Small progress bar showing usage this month.

panels.title: Recent Call Transcripts
panels.content: List of recent calls. Clicking one opens a modal with a full text transcript and an audio waveform player.

visual_prompt_notes: A SaaS settings interface for configuring an AI Voice Agent. The screen is split into a larger left column and smaller right column. The left side shows a grid of 'Voice Profile' cards with play buttons, and a text area for writing call scripts. The right side shows a large green 'Active' toggle switch, a 'Credit Balance' gauge (yellow), and a list of recent calls. Clean white background with yellow and lavender UI accents.
